Well, I don't exactly know how much you've unlocked yet, but in the beginning the first thing you should unlock asap are the rune merchant and the architect. Those 2 are essential if you want to progress in the game. The architect locks your castle, so it isn't randomly generated anymore at the cost of 30% (I think) less money value in it. That's great if you want to practice fighting a boss or certain rooms for example. The rune merchant sells runes of all kinds. You have 1 rune slot in every armor piece (head, chest, cape...). Runes are necessary to progress. However, runes can only be found in fairy chests, which require a certain condition to be opened (for example, kill every enemy in a room or get to the chest without taking damage). After you've unlocked the merchants, expand to the left of the castle first. On the left side, there are many useful things like the hokage class (basically a glass canon, you do tons of damage with almost no health), a longer invincibility period or a lower fee for entering the castle. I hope you can get a little use out of that. Feel free to ask me if you need some more help or tips.

Of course we can play co-op together! Would love to. And you're right about 'less is more'. Having many games can result in the opposite of what you wanted to achieve, at least for me. Example, When I am asked which of the 2 games I want to play, I have no problems choosing. However, when I'm asked which of those 20 games I want to play, I have to think about it carefully because there's so much to choose from. I don't like that.
